Uncompromising to the highest degree, he populates the world with losers, con-men and violent criminals whose nihilism correlates perfectly with the dead-eyed quest of our lead.
An aging and drug-addled ballplayer gets his last shot at the pros but he’ll have to turn his back on a trafficked underage girl to make the team.
An anthology of films focused on the concept of how people move forward despite adversity, from the importance of new beginnings to second chances at the end of dark tunnels.

Chosen as humanity’s representative in a duel against invading aliens, the womanizing Ataru faces off against the alien princess Lum — and the conflict follows him home when Lum invades both planet Earth AND the reluctant Ataru’s love life!

Helena, is about to give birth and face a rosy future in a modern city, as the pregnant wife of an important factory manager. However, all her illusions soon perish, as the dead body of a newborn intersex baby is found in the middle of their factory.
A young woman from the Valley falls for a punk rocker from the Sunset Strip, leaving her caught in the middle of her lifestyle and love.

Morgan Freeman and Ruby Rose lead in this non-stop actioner from the director of Bad Boys. A retired, crooked police commissioner - Damon Hickley blackmails his caretaker - Victoria by kidnapping her daughter and forces her to help him double cross his former team of dirty cops. Victoria is forced to fight her way through drug dealers and underworld thugs in a bid to save her child.

overview.de: Weihnachts-Familienspaß mit Arnold Schwarzenegger als geplagter Daddy im Geschenkestress: Um seinen Sohn nicht zu enttäuschen, muss er eine ausverkaufte Actionfigur auftreiben - mit allen Mitteln!
overview.en: On Christmas Eve, a frantic father battles all sorts of sordid figures around town to get his hands on the must-have toy of the season for his son.
Fearing that a large shipment of whiskey may not reach its destination, a colonel assigns Captain Paul Slater to safeguard the cargo until it arrives.

title.de: WE WERE – Die Zeit die uns bleibt
title.en: We Were: The Time we have left

overview.de: Katie beginnt das Training als junge Prinzessin in einem kleinen europäischen Land, um sich auf den traditionellen Weihnachtsabend vorzubereiten. Doch sie gerät in Schwierigkeiten mit dem Mädchen, das Ansprüche hat, und ihrem Vater, der mit der Verantwortung als Alleinerziehender klarkommen muss.
overview.en: Katie, a former professional ice skater, is hired by the king of San Senova, Alexander, to help his daughter in a Christmas ice skating performance. As Katie spends time in the castle, she and Alex begin to develop feelings for each other.
A man (Billy Ray Cyrus) bonds with a woman (Gina Holden) who helps his son (Liam James) recover from surgery.

title.de: Welpen zu Weihnachten 2: Pfötchen allein zu Haus
title.en: Christmas with the Pups 2: Pups Alone

overview.en: All does not go as planned for two kids left home alone when a pair of neighbors break in on Christmas and steal their possessions.

title.de: When You Finish Saving the World
title.en: When You Finish Saving the World

overview.en: Evelyn tries to parent a teenager at her shelter while her oblivious son Ziggy fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

title.de: Where The Rivers Flow North - Am Ende des Traums

overview.en: A defiant log driver and his American Indian friend resist a power company boss who plans to flood their land, leading to unexpected challenges.
An ex-Marine-turned-mob enforcer must battle his conscience and code of honor when he's forced to clean up his protégé's botched assassination job.
In the Western desert, a young brave avenges the deaths of his tribe after a massacre by the US Army.
Witness the year-long struggle for survival in the Dutch wilderness.
Wild Bill Hickok is a hard-drinking, quick-shooting gunslinger who faces the showdown of his life in this exciting, visually stunning tale.
A news network hires a mercenary to abduct the only surviving Nazi leader who has secrets that could destroy the careers of major political figures.
Special Agent Will Trent has the highest clearance rate in the Georgia Bureau.

When Jenny attends a wedding at a magical ice hotel, she is surprised when she connects with the best man, Craig, and his daughter. Will the romance of the hotel bring them together? Stars Emilie Ullerup and Kevin McGarry.
On Christmas eve, the ghosts of three industrialists return to Earth to help reignite the romantic spark between a young Texas cowboy and teacher.

overview.de: Nach einer anstrengenden Konzerttournee beschließen Aurélien und seine Frau Nanako, die mit ihrem ersten Kind schwanger ist, nach Japan zu ziehen. Als sie sich in einem traditionellen Haus auf dem japanischen Land einrichten, findet Aurélien in einem Brunnen eine alte Rüstung, die seltsame Kreaturen namens Yōkai herbeiruft.
overview.en: Orelsan moves to Japan and finds an ancient armor that awakens strange creatures.

overview.de: In 1997, tensions between religious and secular Turks are rising. Fourteen-year-old Ahmet is sent by his newly converted father to an Islamic boarding school, a "yurt," to learn Muslim values. Ahmet works hard to be a perfect son, but he struggles to fit in with the rough teenagers at the yurt and feels isolated at his secular day school, where he hides his new home from his classmates.
overview.en: In 1997, tensions between religious and secular Turks are rising. Fourteen-year-old Ahmet is sent by his newly converted father to an Islamic boarding school, a "yurt," to learn Muslim values. Ahmet works hard to be a perfect son, but he struggles to fit in with the rough teenagers at the yurt and feels isolated at his secular day school, where he hides his new home from his classmates.
This film tells the story of kung fu brothers Chow and Sii, who agree to carry out a thief's dying wish of taking stolen jewels to his wife.

title.de: Zwei Mann, ein Schwein und die Nacht von Paris

overview.en: Polina Schneider and Soviet creatives travel to Siberia to introduce art to tribes forbidden to interact with foreigners by their gods.

A non-confrontational Jayesh (Ranveer Singh) decides to defy his patriarchal family and flee with his pregnant wife Mudra (Shalini Pandey) to save their unborn daughter from feticide. A screwball, hilarious chase begins as Jayesh's father (Boman Irani) assembles all his might to nab them. Will this unlikely hero manage to create a safe and equal haven for his daughter?

An Indian communications satellite goes off course, raising the potential threat of a major communications disruption worldwide. It is now up to a team of Indian astronauts to course correct the erratic satellite.

Young scientist Kesh along with his invention Kuttaps, a humanoid robot sets out to complete his dad’s invention, Jack and Jill. With the help of his friends, he sets up a lab in a forest and finds a subject Parvathy to test on. But, as the test progress, Parvathy starts landing them in deeper troubles and the success of the invention is at risk.

Innocent days are filled with kindness, at times with bitterness, but are always brimming with light. Mieko and Makio are friends in high school who befriend Eiji, a college student who works with them. Eiji and Makio fall in love, Mieko gives birth to their child, and Makio encounters his old childhood friend Asato. This is a story of youth and their beautiful yet bitter experiences.

overview.de: John Grady Cole, aufgewachsen zwischen wilden Pferden in der rauen Schönheit von Texas, träumt von einem besseren Leben in Mexiko. Als er die Grenze irgendwann tatsächlich hinter sich bringt, warten dort allerdings harte Arbeit und gefährliche Abenteuer auf ihn. Aber auch die Liebe seines Lebens ...
overview.en: An American's dream of living the cowboy way in Mexico turns into a web of murder and betrayal when he falls for the daughter of a dangerous man.

For as long as he can remember, Nathan (Taylor Lautner) has had the uneasy feeling that he's living someone else's life. When he stumbles upon an image of himself as a little boy on a missing persons website, all of Nathan's darkest fears come true.

overview.de: Ein Mann, halb Vampir, halb Sterblicher, wird zum Beschützer der sterblichen Rasse und tötet böse Vampire.
overview.en: A half-vampire, half-mortal man becomes a protector of the mortal race, while slaying evil vampires.

After discovering a video showing what he believes to be his vanished sister Heather, James and a group of friends head into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland, which many believe is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch.

title.de: Bucky Larson: Born to Be a Star
title.en: Bucky Larson: Born to Be a Star

overview.de: A small-town grocery bagger (Nick Swardson) believes he has found his true destiny when he discovers that his conservative parents were once porn stars.
overview.en: An aimless grocery bagger who discovers his conservative parents were once porn stars goes to L.A. hoping to find his destiny in the adult film world.
Follow The Little Ghost on this adventure to see his first sunrise ever!

overview.de: Der Grinch, ein grünes Wesen mit einem Herzen aus Stein, wohnt in den Bergen hoch über dem idyllischen Städtchen Whoville. Übellaunig und verschlagen haßt er eine Sache ganz besonders: fröhliche Menschen, zum Beispiel solche, die sich auf Weihnachten freuen. Also faßt er einen besonders perfiden Plan - er will das Christfest einfach stehlen.
overview.en: A curmudgeon hates the Christmas-loving Whos of Whoville.
Life changes dramatically for a Czech housemaid when the chauffeur gives her three magical hazelnuts.

overview.de: Herzergreifend und saukomisch: originelle Romantikkomödie aus der Schmiede von Comedyguru Judd Apatow ("Beim ersten Mal"). - Ein Jahr, nachdem sie sich kennengelernt haben, verloben sich Edelkoch Tom und Studentin Violet (Jason Segel, Emily Blunt). Aber irgendwie klappt es nie mit der geplanten Hochzeit. Als das Paar ins kalte Michigan umzieht und Tom dafür seinen Job aufgibt, sinkt die Stimmung weiter. Ehe sich die beiden versehen, sind fünf krisenhafte Jahre um - und Violet und Tom müssen noch einmal ganz von vorne anfangen.
overview.en: One year after meeting, Tom proposes to his girlfriend, Violet, but unexpected events keep tripping them up as they look to walk down the aisle together.

title.de: How to Make a Killing: Todsicheres Erbe

overview.de: Becket Redfellow hat Witz, Stil, Bildung und Charme - nur nicht das milliardenschwere Vermögen, das ihm laut seiner Mutter zusteht. Becket entwickelt einen raffiniert-mörderischen Plan, um die sieben Verwandten, die zwischen ihm und dem Erbe stehen, aus dem Weg zu räumen. John Patton Fords Rachethriller besticht mit mörderisch schwarzem Humor und Glen Powell als charismatischem Antihelden.
overview.en: A man will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance from his obscenely wealthy family.
Song Ah finds her new musical academic life daunting. One day, she meets Joong Young, a talented pianist.
After bringing her diplomat boyfriend home for the holidays, a teacher gets a big surprise when she learns he's actually the Prince of Madelvia.

overview.de: Mit der IMF aufgelöst, verbünden sich Ethan und sein Team mit einer verleugneten britischen Agentin, die ein Mitglied dieser Geheimorganisation sein könnte und tritt an gegen ein Netzwerk hochqualifizierter Spezialagenten, dem Syndikat.
overview.en: With his organization shut down, agent Ethan Hunt and his team race against time to stop a dangerous network of rogue operatives turned traitors. To defeat them, he must join forces with an elusive agent as he faces his most impossible mission yet.

overview.de: In Odessa haben Gangster eine noch unbekannte, aber hochgefährliche Technologie in ihre Gewalt gebracht und wollen sie nun weiterverkaufen. Agent Orson Fortune und sein Team sollen dies im Auftrag der britischen Regierung verhindern und mehr über diese neue Technologie herausfinden. Die Spur führt zu dem milliardenschweren Waffenhändler Greg Simmonds. Mit Hilfe eines Hollywoodstars will sich Fortune zu diesem Zutritt verschaffen.
overview.en: Special Agent Orson Fortune and his team of agents recruit one of Hollywood's biggest movie stars to help them on a covert mission when the sale of new weapons technology threatens to disrupt world order.

overview.de: Executive Producer Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson presents Power, a crime drama about a nightclub owner who is also the kingpin of a lucrative drug empire.
overview.en: Executive Producer Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson presents the hit drama Power, centered on a drug kingpin struggling to go from illegal to legitimate in the NYC nightlife.

overview.de: „Raising Kanan“ spielt 1991 in South Jamaica, Queens. Es ist ein Prequel zum „Power“-Serienuniversum. In dem Familiendrama geht es um die Jugend von Kanan Stark, einem Kokainhändler mit einem wachsenden Netzwerk von Dealern in ganz New York City.
overview.en: In Season 5, nothing will stand in the way of Kanan's pursuit of power. After all, this isn't the end for Kanan Stark. It's just the beginning.
The story is about a lawyer suffering from hyperthymestic memory syndrome fighting against a huge power to exonerate his father.
Follow the rapid ascent to fame of this British singer/songwriter with the unforgettable voice, from his humble beginnings to the 2015 Grammys.

title.de: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
title.en: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of

overview.de: Mecha Elmo, Mecha Abby und Mecha Cookie Monster nutzen ihre Fähigkeiten, um Probleme in der Stadt zu lösen: Wie baut man eine Brücke? Warum schmilzt Schnee? Was muss ein Monster tun, um einen Keks zu bekommen? Die drei entdecken dabei die Eigenschaften ihrer Anzüge und lernen zusammenzuarbeiten.
overview.en: Mecha Elmo, Mecha Cookie Monster and Mecha Abby are ready to problem solve the most out-of-this-world situations. Using their robo-skills, the Mecha Builders are here to help -- it just might take them a few tries before they save the day!
A gifted writer tries to write his next book while his wife begins to attract the attention of another man.

title.de: Thomas & seine Freunde: Wirklich Nützliche Loks
title.en: Thomas & Friends: Railway Stories - Really Helpful Engines

overview.en: When Gordon needs help, Thomas takes on extra work alone to prove himself. But a busy day on Sodor shows that even useful engines need their friends.

overview.de: Gegnerische Alien-Rassen, die Autobots und die Deceptions, bringen ihren Kampf auf die Erde und setzen die Zukunft der Menschheit aufs Spiel.
overview.en: Two intergalactic races of robots crash-land on Earth; the future of humankind hangs in balance.

overview.de: Der Kampf um die Erde geht weiter. Sam Witwicky, der mittlerweile aufs College geht, erfährt die Wahrheit über die geschichtlichen Ursprünge der Transformers. Er muss sein Schicksal annehmen und gemeinsam mit Optimus Prime und Bumblebee den gewaltigen Kampf aufnehmen - gegen die Decepticons, die stärker als zuvor zurückgekehrt sind, mit dem Plan, unsere Welt zu zerstören.
overview.en: Sam Witwicky (Shia LaBeouf) holds the key to defeating an ancient Decepticon.

overview.de: Ein geheimnisvolles Ereignis der jüngsten Vergangenheit droht, einen Krieg von solchen Ausmaßen zu entfesseln, dass die Transformers ohne Hilfe nicht in der Lage sein werden, den Planeten zu retten. Jetzt müssen Bumblebee und Cade Yeager (Mark Wahlberg) die Autobots gegen ihren einstigen Verbündeten in die ultimative Schlacht führen, um die Menschheit vor ihrer Vernichtung zu bewahren.
overview.en: When Optimus Prime turns against mankind, Bumblebee leads the Autobots into a battle to save Earth.

overview.de: In der Vorweihnachtszeit kehrt Amelia Hughes, eine karriereorientierte App-Entwicklerin aus Chicago, die so gar nicht in Weihnachtsstimmung ist, in ihr Heimatstädtchen Christmas Creek zurück, um die Bedeutung von Weihnachten wiederzuentdecken.
